findings.title: A destructive receiving home
findings.claim: The possessive source-word in أُمُّهُ makes the abyss a receiving origin whose expected nurture is reversed into destruction.
findings.mechanism: أُمُّهُ carries the mother and bearer relation, with its core maternal position and nurturing extension, while هَاوِيَةٌ independently supplies the falling abyss; their contact turns the abyss from a bare endpoint into an intimate but anti-nurturing destination.
findings.reader_payoff: The line can be heard as a horrifying homecoming while its plain statement that his mother is an abyss remains intact.
findings.containment: The maternal reception is a qualified resonance of the two focus words. It does not reparse أُمُّهُ, and it does not claim that the text literally describes a womb, walls, or a spatial enclosure.

epistemic.reason: The trusted published finding supplies the paired focus branches and strong relation; the receiving-home implication is the bounded interpretive consequence of their contact.

friction_notes: The complete hermetic packet contains 23 candidates; each is decided exactly once. The six trusted published findings were assessed against their exact focus branches and connection evidence. The legacy reader-walk candidates were retained only where their focus carrier, independent contextual trigger, changed reading, and boundary were explicit; their source-only nominated branches and trusted reject pairings were excluded where applicable.

The ten legacy_unbound HFT summary records have empty anchor_refs and branch_refs. Their source-specific carrier, independent trigger, and focus-return trace is unavailable, so they are rejected as HFT candidates even where separately anchored reader-walk or published evidence supports a related finding.

The packet contains many no-value, contrast-only, and reciprocal connection rows. They were not exhaustively inventoried; relevant positive and boundary connections are retained on findings, while availability without an independent carrier-trigger-return mechanism was not promoted to an additional finding.
